name: Udyam MSME Online Registration
marathi_name: उद्यम नोंदणी (सूक्ष्म, लघु व मध्यम उद्योग)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Govt. of India
department: District Industries Centre (DIC) / MSME Directorate, Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (MSMED) Act, 2006
one_line_description: Foundational 12-digit digital identity for MSMEs; mandatory for state subsidies, collateral-free credit, and industrial power tariff subsidies.
documents_preview: Aadhaar Number of Proprietor / Partners / Directors
PAN Card of Enterprise / Entity
Bank Account details & IFSC
NIC 2-digit & 4-digit activity code

name: Goods and Services Tax (GST) Registration
issuing_authority: Maharashtra Goods & Services Tax Department / CBIC
act_and_rule: Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 & Central GST Act, 2017
one_line_description: Mandatory state and central tax registration allowing commercial invoicing, input tax credits, and inter-state purchase of capital machinery.
documents_preview: PAN Card of Business Entity
Proof of Business Premise (MIDC Allotment Letter / Electricity Bill / Rent Deed)
Cancelled Cheque / Bank Statement
Letter of Authorization / Board Resolution

name: Professional Tax Enrollment (PTEC) & Registration (PTRC)
issuing_authority: Department of Goods & Services Tax, Government of Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975
fee_structure: ₹2,500/year (PTEC) + monthly deductions per staff salary slab (PTRC)
one_line_description: PTEC certifies the employer/proprietor's professional tax liability; PTRC enables monthly deduction and remittance for salaried employees.
documents_preview: PAN Card
GSTIN Certificate
Electricity bill of business address
List of employees and gross salary details

name: Maharashtra Shops & Establishment Registration (Gumasta)
marathi_name: महाराष्ट्र दुकाने व आस्थापना नोंदणी / सूचना (गुमास्ता)
issuing_authority: Labour Commissionerate / Local Urban Body via Aaple Sarkar
department: Industries, Energy and Labour Department, Government of Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 2017
typical_timeline: Instant (Online Intimation for <10 workers) / 5–7 Days (≥10 workers)
fee_structure: ₹0 for Intimation (<10 workers); ₹1,000–₹5,000 for Registration (≥10 workers)
one_line_description: Statutory local labor sanction governing working hours, employee records, statutory leaves, and primary municipal proof of commercial operation.
documents_preview: Identity & Address Proof of Employer
Photo of Shop / Establishment with Marathi Signboard in Devanagari script
Electricity Bill / Rent Agreement
Partnership Deed / MoA / AoA (if applicable)

name: Industrial Building Plan Approval & Construction Permission
marathi_name: औद्योगिक इमारत नकाशा मंजुरी व विकास परवानगी
issuing_authority: MIDC Special Planning Authority (SPA) / Municipal Town Planning / Collectorate
department: Industries Department / Urban Development Department, Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning (MRTP) Act, 1966 & Unified DCR
fee_structure: Calculated per sq. meter built-up area and scrutiny charges as per MIDC/ULB rates
one_line_description: Technical sanction of architectural layout, setbacks, structural stability, and zoning parameters before initiating any civil construction.
documents_preview: Plot Allotment Letter / Possession Receipt / 7/12 Extract
Architectural drawings in CAD / AutoDCR format signed by licensed architect
Structural Stability Certificate from registered structural engineer
Soil investigation test report

name: Provisional Fire NOC (Pre-Construction Blueprint Sanction)
marathi_name: तात्पुरता अग्निशमन ना हरकत दाखला (बांधकाम पूर्व)
issuing_authority: Chief Fire Officer, MIDC Fire Services / Municipal Fire Brigade
department: Urban Development Department / MIDC Fire Brigade, Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act, 2006
fee_structure: Fire Protection Fund fee assessed as per industrial hazard class & plot size
one_line_description: Scrutiny of fire prevention blueprints specifying fire hydrants, emergency exits, access road width, and underground static water tanks before construction.
documents_preview: Site plan showing ingress/egress points and turning radius for fire tenders
Detailed floor plans indicating fire escape staircases and sprinkler layout
Water requirement calculation for firefighting reserves
Form A signed by licensed Fire Safety Agency

name: MPCB Consent to Establish (CTE)
marathi_name: महाराष्ट्र प्रदूषण नियंत्रण मंडळ - स्थापनेची संमती (CTE)
department: Environment and Climate Change Department, Government of Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 & Air Act, 1981
fee_structure: Tiered by capital investment (e.g. ₹5,000 for <₹25L, ₹15,000 for ₹25L–₹1Cr, up to ₹50,000)
one_line_description: Statutory environmental consent required before civil work or machinery installation; strictly legally required prior to Factory License application.
documents_preview: Manufacturing process flow chart with material balance
Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) / Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) design proposal
Air pollution control system details (Chimney / Cyclone / Scrubber)
Audited balance sheet / CA capital investment certificate

name: Factory Building Plan Approval & Factory License
marathi_name: कारखाना नकाशा मंजुरी व कारखाना परवाना (DISH)
issuing_authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health (DISH), Maharashtra
department: Industries, Energy and Labour Department, Government of Maharashtra
fee_structure: Graduated scale based on connected horse power (HP) and maximum worker headcount (₹2,500–₹25,000)
one_line_description: Workplace occupational health, worker safety, ventilation, and machinery guarding approval; legally requires MPCB Consent to Establish first.
documents_preview: MPCB Consent to Establish (CTE) Copy
Approved building plan drawings showing machinery layout and worker passages
Form 1 (Application for permission to construct/extend factory)
Form 2 (Application for registration and grant of license)

name: Steam Boiler Registration & Pipeline Drawing Approval
department: Industries, Energy and Labour Department, Government of Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Indian Boilers Act, 1923 & Maharashtra Boiler Rules, 1962
conditional_reason: Required only if unit utilizes steam boilers or closed vessels under pressure exceeding 25 liters capacity.
fee_structure: Based on boiler rating surface area (₹3,000 to ₹15,000)
one_line_description: Mandatory pre-commissioning inspection, hydraulic pressure test, and safety valve certification for high-pressure industrial steam boilers.
documents_preview: Maker's Certificate (Form II & Form III) from boiler manufacturer
Steam piping isometric drawings and material test certificates
Hydraulic test report witnessed by Boiler Inspector

name: PESO Petroleum / Chemical Bulk Storage License
marathi_name: पेट्रोलियम, वायू व स्फोटक साठा परवाना (PESO)
issuing_authority: Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO), West Circle
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Govt. of India
act_and_rule: Petroleum Act, 1934 & Static and Mobile Pressure Vessels (Unfired) Rules, 2016
fee_structure: Calculated by storage volume (e.g. ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 per tank installation)
one_line_description: Mandatory site safety layout verification and storage license for bulk storage of inflammable solvents, chemicals, compressed LPG/hydrogen.
documents_preview: Approved site plan showing safety distances from boundaries and ignition sources
Fabrication drawings of storage vessel and pressure relief valves
Safety audit and hazardous area classification report

name: FSSAI Food Safety Manufacturing License / Registration
marathi_name: अन्न सुरक्षा व मानके प्राधिकरण परवाना (FSSAI)
department: Medical Education and Drugs Department / FSSAI Western Region
act_and_rule: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 & Licensing Regulations, 2011
one_line_description: Mandatory food hygiene and safety certification confirming sanitary manufacturing premises, potable water laboratory test, and recall plans.
documents_preview: Food Safety Management System (FSMS) plan or standard operating protocol
Laboratory testing report of processing water by NABL accredited lab
List of food categories, machinery specifications, and horse power used
Medical fitness certificates of all food handling workers

name: Final Fire NOC & Occupancy Clearance
marathi_name: अंतिम अग्निशमन दाखला व भोगवटा मंजुरी
issuing_authority: Chief Fire Officer, MIDC Fire Brigade / Municipal Fire Services
department: Urban Development Department / MIDC Fire Services, Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act, 2006
fee_structure: Physical on-site inspection fees as per published schedule
one_line_description: Physical site verification confirming functional hydrants, alarms, smoke detectors, and emergency lighting installed as per provisional NOC conditions.
phase_name: Phase 4: Operational Licenses, Consents & Utility Connections
documents_preview: Copy of Provisional Fire NOC
Completion Certificate from registered Licensed Fire Agency (Form B)
Photograph proof of static fire tank and booster pump installation

name: MPCB Consent to Operate (CTO)
marathi_name: महाराष्ट्र प्रदूषण नियंत्रण मंडळ - संचालनाची संमती (CTO)
department: Environment and Climate Change Department, Government of Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 & Air Act, 1981
fee_structure: Annual or 5-year block fee commensurate with capital investment tier
one_line_description: Final environmental green-light permitting commercial operations, effluent discharge within permissible standards, and emission generation.
phase_name: Phase 4: Operational Licenses, Consents & Utility Connections
documents_preview: Copy of MPCB Consent to Establish (CTE) & compliance status report
Photographs and commissioning certificate of ETP / STP / scrubbers
Analysis report of treated effluent and stack emissions by MPCB recognized lab

name: MSEDCL Industrial Power Connection / Load Sanction
marathi_name: महावितरण औद्योगिक वीज जोडणी व भार मंजुरी
issuing_authority: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL / महावितरण)
act_and_rule: Electricity Act, 2003 & MERC Supply Code Regulations
fee_structure: Application fee + Security deposit calculated per kW/kVA contracted load
one_line_description: Sanction and physical meter energization of commercial industrial electricity connection with tariff subsidy eligibility under Maharashtra Industrial Policy.
phase_name: Phase 4: Operational Licenses, Consents & Utility Connections
documents_preview: Proof of ownership / lease agreement of premise
Test report (Form A) issued by Licensed Electrical Contractor
Factory License / Gumasta copy
No Objection Certificate from local authority

name: Industrial Piped Water Connection & Allocation
marathi_name: औद्योगिक पाणी पुरवठा जोडणी व कोटा वाटप
issuing_authority: MIDC Water Works / Municipal Water Dept. / Maharashtra Jeevan Pradhikaran
department: Water Resources Department / MIDC Engineering, Maharashtra
act_and_rule: MIDC Water Supply Regulations / Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act
fee_structure: Pipe connection charges + refundable security deposit based on required daily m3 quota
one_line_description: Allotment of daily industrial water quota, pipeline tapping sanction, and commercial volumetric water meter installation.
phase_name: Phase 4: Operational Licenses, Consents & Utility Connections
documents_preview: Plumbing schematic drawing showing industrial vs domestic line separation
Water requirement calculation sheet
MIDC plot allotment letter / property tax receipt

name: Local Municipal / Gram Panchayat Trade License
issuing_authority: Local Municipal Corporation (e.g. BMC, PMC, PCMC, NMMC) / Gram Panchayat
department: Urban Development / Rural Development Department, Maharashtra
act_and_rule: Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act / Maharashtra Village Panchayats Act
fee_structure: Annual trade license fee assessed by local ward office as per schedule
one_line_description: Civic clearance permitting commercial operations and trade activities within municipal or rural jurisdiction boundaries.
phase_name: Phase 4: Operational Licenses, Consents & Utility Connections
documents_preview: Shops & Establishment Registration / Factory License
Fire Department NOC
Property Tax No Dues Certificate
Premises lease deed / ownership deed
